versions.localizedDescription:
Orivyn 0.1.1 build 9 — unfinished development preview

Unsigned ARM64 IPA for iOS 26 or later. Your installer must sign it for your account/device. Preserve existing app data and signing identity when updating. Models download separately.

Includes the current local assistant, reviewed read workflows, native tools and local image analysis, and new history receive/recovery protections. Automatic live sync is still disabled. New experimental engine, vision model, pairing and scheduler improvements are NOT included.

Exact-source verification: 1,032 native core tests executed, 5 skipped, zero failures; unsigned device build and IPA structure/resource checks passed. UI-0 passed. UI-2 failed waiting for a hittable Files Cancel control after Photos cancellation; general production autonomy failed the required search/read grounded-answer test. Other UI/model results are separate, not full acceptance.

General autonomy and broad vision remain unreliable. Intermittent Files UI issues remain. Physical-device installation, signing refresh, voice, memory/thermal behavior and runtime remain unverified. This is not completed 1.0.0.

Orivyn 0.1.1 build 8 — development preview

Unsigned ARM64 IPA for iOS 26 or later; Installation and any required signing are handled by your installer. Strata installation/runtime has not been verified. Preserve the existing app data and signing identity when updating. Models download separately.

Includes the current local assistant, reviewed read-workflow fixes, native tools/vision runtime, and durable text-sync storage. Live automatic sync is not enabled. General unreviewed autonomy and broad vision reliability remain unfinished. A UI test found that New conversation did not clear the previous response after a real model reply. Physical-device installation, signing refresh, memory/thermal behavior and runtime acceptance remain unverified. This is not completed 1.0.0.

This package passed unsigned device compilation, runtime archive validation, IPA structure/resource checks and independent identity/hash inspection. Native unit/UI tests were not run for this exact package. Parent implementation fb146910 separately passed 1,014 native tests (5 skipped, zero failures), all 129 portable persistence tests and six reviewed-read real-model cases; its general-agent and one UI test failed. Vision's frozen synthetic baseline matched 8/10 cases. None of these results certifies general autonomy, reliable broad vision, automatic sync or physical-device readiness.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
